conclusions: The generated function mmay_g_f_08c59bfc1cc88692ccc2a1e841a98b04 dominates the named Marimay frames in both exact binaries. It also contains inlined runtime logic, so a function label does not identify the responsible operation.

The sampler includes the deliberate suspended startup interval. The totals cannot be interpreted as CPU-time percentages or before/after speed comparisons. One after profile is empty and is retained without replacement.

The profile does not establish a cause for the repeated +3.78/+3.49 percent Native min-heap median regression. Existing binary inspection shows unchanged array/helper entry addresses and relocated later functions; relocation is an observation, not proof of causation.
No layout tuning, acceptance-gate changes, production edits or new timing series were performed. The shared string candidate remains rejected.
